findings.detail: The driver active-container check alone is not a global atomic semaphore. The updated policy explicitly requires Root-only serialized dispatch and treats that check as supplemental; this is adequate under the declared dispatch model, while direct concurrent CLI launches remain unsupported.

limits: This audit verifies prepared inputs and policy only; it does not claim the Count-125 native route ran or passed.

verified.clocking: The 8.000 ns XDC is part of the pinned recipe and is read before synth_design. Tcl asserts one component clock with exact expected period and default 50% waveform; native report parser requires [0,4] for this target. The separate 10 ns XDC remains explicit for the 100 MHz comparison.
verified.dispatch_control: Policy now limits native launches to Root-owned serialized dispatch, counts emulator/focused/canonical/native work in the global two-slot decision, and explicitly disallows independent concurrent CLI launchers. Docker active-name count is supplemental rather than an atomic cross-agent scheduler.
verified.hardware_scope: Prepared OOC component route only; bitstream generation and hardware contact are false; no board I/O/full-parent timing or FPS/decode claim.
verified.license_and_network: Container uses the same host network mode as the validated Count control; legitimate existing license is mounted read-only and not logged; no hostid/MAC changes.

runtime_bounds.stop_gates: Host availability and PSI gates checked before dispatch and monitored during flow; cancellation is bounded.

verified.source_composition: Fresh RTL source set is exactly the frozen V110 Count source composition; focused V111 Header is correctly absent from this baseline trial.
verified.synthesis_and_flow: OOC synthesis from RTL, no checkpoint input, default synthesis directive omitted from CLI, Default opt/route, ExtraNetDelay_high placement, and retained stage reports including checks/methodology/DRC/CDC/utilization/high-fanout/mapping.
